items.text:
आयुः कर्म च वित्तञ्च विद्या निधनमेव च ।
पञ्चैतानि हि सृज्यन्ते गर्भस्थस्यैव देहिनः ॥ १ ॥
items.tr:
āyuḥ karma ca vittañca vidyā nidhanameva ca |
pañcaitāni hi sṛjyante garbhasthasyaiva dehinaḥ || 1 ||
items.en: Length of life, work, wealth, learning and the time of death: these five are fixed for a being while it is still in the womb.

items.text:
साधुभ्यस्ते निवर्तन्ते पुत्रामित्राणि बान्धवाः ।
ये च तैः सह गन्तारस्तध्दर्मात्सुकृतं कुलम् ॥ २ ॥
items.tr:
sādhubhyaste nivartante putrāmitrāṇi bāndhavāḥ |
ye ca taiḥ saha gantārastadhdarmātsukṛtaṃ kulam || 2 ||
items.en: Sons, friends and relatives turn away from holy people; but those who follow such people bring merit to their whole family.

items.text:
दर्शनाध्यानसंस्पर्शैर्मत्सी कूर्मी च पक्षिणी ।
शिशुपालयते नित्यं तथा सज्जनसड्गतिः ॥ ३ ॥
items.tr:
darśanādhyānasaṃsparśairmatsī kūrmī ca pakṣiṇī |
śiśupālayate nityaṃ tathā sajjanasaḍgatiḥ || 3 ||
items.en: A fish, a tortoise and a bird care for their young by sight, by thought and by touch; in the same way, the company of good people nourishes us.

items.text:
यावत्स्वस्थो ह्ययं देहो यावन्मृत्युश्च दूरतः ।
तावदात्महितं कुर्यात् प्राणान्ते किं करिष्यति ॥ ४ ॥
items.tr:
yāvatsvastho hyayaṃ deho yāvanmṛtyuśca dūrataḥ |
tāvadātmahitaṃ kuryāt prāṇānte kiṃ kariṣyati || 4 ||
items.en: While this body is healthy and death is far away, do what is good for your soul; what can you do when life is ending?

items.text:
कामधेनुगुण विद्या ह्यकाले फलदायिनी ।
प्रवासे मातृसदृशी विद्या गुप्तं धनं स्मृतम् ॥ ५ ॥
items.tr:
kāmadhenuguṇa vidyā hyakāle phaladāyinī |
pravāse mātṛsadṛśī vidyā guptaṃ dhanaṃ smṛtam || 5 ||
items.en: Learning is like the wish-granting cow: it gives fruit even in hard times. Away from home it cares for you like a mother; learning is called hidden wealth.

items.text:
एको ऽपि गुणवान् पुत्रो निर्गुणैश् च शतैर् वरः ।
एकश् चन्द्रस् तमो हन्ति न च ताराः सहस्रशः ॥ ६ ॥
items.tr:
eko 'pi guṇavān putro nirguṇaiś ca śatair varaḥ |
ekaś candras tamo hanti na ca tārāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 6 ||
items.en: One son with good qualities is better than a hundred without them; one moon drives away the dark, which thousands of stars cannot.

items.text:
मूर्खश्चिरायुर्जातोऽपि तस्माज्जातमृतो वरः ।
मृतः स चाऽल्पदुःखाय यावज्जीवं जडोदहेत् ॥ ७ ॥
items.tr:
mūrkhaścirāyurjāto'pi tasmājjātamṛto varaḥ |
mṛtaḥ sa cā'lpaduḥkhāya yāvajjīvaṃ jaḍodahet || 7 ||
items.en: A fool who lives long is worse than a child who dies at birth; the dead child brings brief sorrow, but the fool burns you as long as he lives.

items.text:
कुग्रामवासः कुलहीनसेवा ।
कुभोजनं क्रोधमुखी च भार्या ॥
पुत्रश्च मूर्खो विधवा च कन्या ।
विनाग्निमेते प्रदहन्ति कायम् ॥ ८ ॥
items.tr:
kugrāmavāsaḥ kulahīnasevā |
kubhojanaṃ krodhamukhī ca bhāryā ||
putraśca mūrkho vidhavā ca kanyā |
vināgnimete pradahanti kāyam || 8 ||
items.en: Living in a bad village, serving a man of low birth, bad food, a wife with an angry face, a foolish son and a widowed daughter burn the body without fire.

items.text:
किं तया क्रियते धेन्वा या न दोग्ध्री न गर्भिणी ।
कोऽर्थः पुत्रेण जातेन यो न विद्वान्न भक्तिमान् ॥ ९ ॥
items.tr:
kiṃ tayā kriyate dhenvā yā na dogdhrī na garbhiṇī |
ko'rthaḥ putreṇa jātena yo na vidvānna bhaktimān || 9 ||
items.en: What use is a cow that gives no milk and bears no calf? What good is a son who is neither learned nor devoted?

items.text:
संसारतापदग्धानां त्रयो विश्रान्तेहेतवः ।
अपत्यं च कलत्रं च सतां सड्गतिरेव च ॥ १० ॥
items.tr:
saṃsāratāpadagdhānāṃ trayo viśrāntehetavaḥ |
apatyaṃ ca kalatraṃ ca satāṃ saḍgatireva ca || 10 ||
items.en: For people burned by the troubles of the world, three things give rest: children, a wife, and the company of good people.

items.text:
सकृज्जल्पन्ति राजानः सकृज्जल्पन्ति पण्डिताः ।
सकृत्कन्याः प्रदीयन्ते त्रीण्येतानि सकृत्सकृत् ॥ ११ ॥
items.tr:
sakṛjjalpanti rājānaḥ sakṛjjalpanti paṇḍitāḥ |
sakṛtkanyāḥ pradīyante trīṇyetāni sakṛtsakṛt || 11 ||
items.en: Kings speak only once, wise men speak only once, and a daughter is given in marriage only once: these three happen just once.

items.text:
एकाकिना तपो द्वाभ्यां पठनं गायनं त्रिभिः ।
चतुर्भिर्गमनं क्षेत्रं पंचभिर्बहुभी रणम् ॥ १२ ॥
items.tr:
ekākinā tapo dvābhyāṃ paṭhanaṃ gāyanaṃ tribhiḥ |
caturbhirgamanaṃ kṣetraṃ paṃcabhirbahubhī raṇam || 12 ||
items.en: Do penance alone, study with two, sing with three, travel with four, farm with five, and fight with many.

items.text:
सा भार्या या शुचिर्दक्षा सा भार्या या पतिव्रता ।
सा भार्या या पतिप्रीता साभार्या सत्यवादिनो ॥ १३ ॥
items.tr:
sā bhāryā yā śucirdakṣā sā bhāryā yā pativratā |
sā bhāryā yā patiprītā sābhāryā satyavādino || 13 ||
items.en: She is a true wife who is clean and capable, faithful to her husband, loving toward him, and truthful.

items.text:
अपुत्रस्य गृहं शून्यं दिशः शुन्यास्त्वबांधवाः ।
मूर्खस्य हृदयं शून्यं सर्वशून्या दरिद्रता ॥ १४ ॥
items.tr:
aputrasya gṛhaṃ śūnyaṃ diśaḥ śunyāstvabāṃdhavāḥ |
mūrkhasya hṛdayaṃ śūnyaṃ sarvaśūnyā daridratā || 14 ||
items.en: The house of a man with no son is empty, all directions are empty for one without relatives, a fool's heart is empty, and for the poor everything is empty.

items.text:
अनभ्यासे विषं शास्त्रमजीर्णे भोजनं विषम् ।
दरिद्रस्य विषं गोष्ठी वृध्दस्य तरुणी विषम् ॥ १५ ॥
items.tr:
anabhyāse viṣaṃ śāstramajīrṇe bhojanaṃ viṣam |
daridrasya viṣaṃ goṣṭhī vṛdhdasya taruṇī viṣam || 15 ||
items.en: Learning not practised is poison, food not digested is poison, social gatherings are poison to a poor man, and a young wife is poison to an old man.

items.text:
त्यजेध्दर्म दयाहीनं विद्याहीनं गुरुं त्यजेत् ।
त्यजेत्क्रोधमुखीं भार्यान्निः स्नेहानबंधवांस्त्यजेत् ॥ १६ ॥
items.tr:
tyajedhdarma dayāhīnaṃ vidyāhīnaṃ guruṃ tyajet |
tyajetkrodhamukhīṃ bhāryānniḥ snehānabaṃdhavāṃstyajet || 16 ||
items.en: Give up a religion that has no compassion, a teacher who has no learning, a wife with an angry face, and relatives who have no love.

items.text:
अध्वा जरा मनुष्याणां वाजिनां बंधनं जरा ।
अमैथुनं जरा स्त्रीणां वस्त्राणामातपं जरा ॥ १७ ॥
items.tr:
adhvā jarā manuṣyāṇāṃ vājināṃ baṃdhanaṃ jarā |
amaithunaṃ jarā strīṇāṃ vastrāṇāmātapaṃ jarā || 17 ||
items.en: Constant travel ages a man, being tied up ages a horse, lack of love-making ages a woman, and sun ages clothes.

items.text:
कः कालः कानि मित्राणि को देशः कौ व्ययागमौ ।
कश् चाहं का च मे शक्तिर् इति चिन्त्यं मुहुर्मुहुः ॥ १८ ॥
items.tr:
kaḥ kālaḥ kāni mitrāṇi ko deśaḥ kau vyayāgamau |
kaś cāhaṃ kā ca me śaktir iti cintyaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 18 ||
items.en: Think again and again: What is the time? Who are my friends? What is this place? What do I earn and spend? Who am I, and what is my strength?

items.text:
अग्निर्देवो द्विजातीनां मुनीनां हृदि दैवतम् ।
प्रतिमा त्वल्पबुध्दीनां सर्वत्र समदर्शिनाम् ॥ १९ ॥
items.tr:
agnirdevo dvijātīnāṃ munīnāṃ hṛdi daivatam |
pratimā tvalpabudhdīnāṃ sarvatra samadarśinām || 19 ||
items.en: For the twice-born, God is in the fire; for sages, God is in the heart; for those of little understanding, God is in images; for those who see all as equal, God is everywhere.
